text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

The panel's composition on its own tells you almost nothing. Laboratory medicine and hospital administration are heavily female fields, so an all-woman panel is close to what chance would produce — it isn't evidence of bias, and raising it will make you look like someone searching for an explanation rather than asking for one.

Note also that your qualifications are deeper academically, but the role is management. A master's plus a management course plus "broad leadership experience" is a plausible fit for a department head; a PhD and eight years running a section is not automatically stronger.

Pursue the written explanation instead — that's your legitimate claim, and the delay is the real problem. Send a formal follow-up with a deadline.
